topic: how much money Roblox pays the people who build its games
storyAngle: Roblox is a platform where the creators are paid close to a billion dollars a year.
doNotClaim: Developer exchange fees are what Roblox reports paying out to developers and creators in 2024; do not compute a percent or cents-per-dollar of bookings.
Bookings is Roblox's own measure of what users spend; revenue is recognised over time, so the two differ.
Do not compare the creator payout to the net loss; do not call anyone a kid.

facts.claim: Roblox 2024 developer exchange fees (the amounts it paid to developers and creators) were $922.8 million, up 25% from $740.8 million in 2023.
Roblox 2024 bookings were $4,369.1 million and revenue was $3,602.0 million.
